notes: Ride the bus, keep your pairing file, and stay where you teleported to. Public transport: bus, tram, metro and train that actually stop, waiting at each stop and easing in and out rather than cruising through. Your pairing file is now saved to Files (On My iPhone → Mirage → Pairing) and can be shared off the phone, so reinstalling no longer means redoing the pairing. Fixed: a new teleport no longer snaps back to the previous one after ten seconds; Walk and Drive work on mobile data instead of animating a journey your phone never took; dismissing the Mobile Data prompt no longer leaves “Applying” on screen; a failed teleport shows its reason instead of hiding it behind the pin card, and Retry actually retries. Stopping a spoof no longer drops the tunnel, so teleporting again is fast.
